name: agent-handoff
description: Keep long AI coding sessions aligned with a concise repo-local handoff file.

interface.shortDescription: Maintain repo-local handoff notes for long Codex sessions.
interface.longDescription: Agent Handoff helps Codex preserve the original goal, current focus, key decisions, failed attempts, changed files, and next steps in a concise .agent-handoff/HANDOFF.md or root HANDOFF.md that future sessions or other AI coding agents can read.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Handoff for this project.
Read .agent-handoff/HANDOFF.md or HANDOFF.md and continue from the current focus.
Update the active handoff file before ending meaningful work.
